content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant the premises known as Unit #3, located at 123 Maple Street, Springfield Township, State of Novaria.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Term_of_Lease
content_blocks.text: This lease shall commence on June 1, 2024, and terminate on May 31, 2025, unless terminated earlier as provided herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Rental_Payment
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay the monthly rent in the amount of $1,200.00, due on the first day of each month, in advance.
